en: Two-sided vintage postcard. Front: a sepia portrait of a bearded man with the printed caption "DOMN AURELIU VICTOR MURESIAN (1884.)". Reverse: printed header in Romanian/German/Hungarian reading "ROMÂNIA – CARTA POSTALĂ – KORRESPONDENZ-KARTE — LEVELEZŐ-LAP", a green 5 FILLER stamp cancelled with a postmark reading "BRASSO", a purple handstamp "MUZEUL JUD. BV.", a short handwritten greeting in German, and an address to a recipient in "Kronstadt, Rossmarkt 2".
